€3P. (जुहोति, हुत; pass. हूयते; caus. हावयति-ते; desid. जुहूषति) 
__1 To offer or present (as oblation to fire); make an offering to or in honour of a deity (with acc.); sacrifice; यो मन्त्रपूतां तनुमप्यहौषीत् [[R. 13. 45]]; जटाधरः सन् जुहुधीह पावकम् [[Ki. 1. 44]]; हविर्जुहुधि पावकम् [[Bk. 20. 11]]; [[Ms. 3. 87]]; [[Y. 1. 99.]] 
__2 To perform a sacrifice. 3 To eat.

ind. 
__1 An interjection of calling. 
__2 Of contempt. 
__3 Of pride. 
__4 Of grief (oh ! ah ! alas &c.).
